title: About Us
subtitle: About Mozshaq
description: We are Mozshaq Consultoria e Serviços, a genuinely Mozambican company that offers integrated solutions in studies and specialized consulting for the sustainable development of Mozambique.
description2: Established in 2013, MOZSHAQ has a specialized technical team in its areas of operation, focused on technical assistance and services, providing its clients with local responses with international standards.
description3: The experience acquired over more than 12 years of existence and the knowledge accumulated by employees constitute a competitive advantage for the company and contribute to solving the challenges posed by the need to fully satisfy our clients.
description4: We strive every day to deliver added value solutions to our clients in any sector of activity, allowing them to stand out in this increasingly competitive market.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: Optimize organizations through national and international standards to reduce costs, increase productivity and mitigate environmental impacts and health risks, ensuring continuous sustainable development.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To become the best and preferred Mozambican company for technical assistance in Studies and Specialized Consulting, Project Management, Training and Outsourcing solutions.

team.title: Our Greatest Asset: Our Team
team.description: With about 60% of a young and dynamic team, MOZSHAQ has a multidisciplinary team, motivated by the common denominator: sustainable development.
team.description2: We prioritize knowledge transfer and are committed to building internal capacity. In all projects, we find an external consultant to add value to our local consultants through the knowledge transfer tool.
